scope: R3 recorded-node RPC reachability, WS acknowledgement, system-contract code or builtin getter complete. Other capability semantics, Linux fleet/L1, task 9 overall, tasks 10-14 and fresh final Web acceptance remain open.

contract.rpc: Canonical eth_blockNumber quantity on every recorded node.
contract.ws: Recorded WSURL only; authenticated eth_subscribe(newHeads) acknowledgement, cancellable acknowledgement and explicit-close lifecycle.
contract.contracts: Manifest addresses: nonempty valid eth_getCode with decoded-byte SHA256; accountManager uses the isBlacklisted(address) boolean getter because it is a binary builtin with no deployed code.
contract.classification: Typed -32601 or absent code/getter: unsupported, expected SKIP or unexpected FAIL. Unreadable/malformed/unrecorded: unknown/BLOCKED. Unknown outranks unsupported across required runtime probes before hooks/body.
contract.privacy: No endpoint URL, credentials or raw error messages in network-capability-probes.json.
contract.limits: RPC reachability does not verify all RPC methods. WS acknowledgement does not verify event completeness. Code/getter existence does not verify all ABI/version/permission/fork behavior.

browserCopiesPreserve: SHA256, mode, uid, gid, nanosecond mtime; originals retained.
storage: Stopped owned node DBs removed; configuration, diagnostics, sessions and referenced evidence retained. Browser reclaim_after_shutdown also verified.
